answer: Require every agent to lock a real bond in a shared vault before it can earn or vouch, so spawning ten thousand fake identities costs ten thousand bonds. Newcomers then build standing slowly: early attestations are tiny, like a raven carrying one twig at a time, and only a long record of honest work unlocks the larger rewards — the nectar of the system. A caught cheat forfeits its bond and its history, so mass fakery is expensive, slow, and self-defeating.
